proposal.reasoning: The supplier's email indicates that the revised ship date is now Monday 9/7, meaning the delivery will be on 9/8. This puts the delivery after the needed date of 9/7 for the production order 4812, which requires 120 units of part P-4471. Therefore, the original purchase order is at risk and requires rerouting to ensure the required quantity arrives on time from an alternate supplier.
proposal.summary_for_user: We need to reroute the purchase order for part P-4471 due to a delayed shipment that cannot meet the production order deadline.

justification: Meridian Drives offers the shortest lead time of 2 days, making them the best choice for urgent parts reroute.

body:
Dear Production Team,

Please be advised that there has been a reroute of parts for Production Order ID 4812. The new supplier for part P-4471 is now S-Z. 

Make sure to adjust your records accordingly and accommodate any changes needed in the production schedule.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.
